name: Glitchfest
description: A glitch effect on the project's transport. Twelve rows: stutter, shuffle, reverse, scratch, freeze, tape stop and start, pitch, crush, filter sweep, gate, pan and an echo throw. Draw blocks into four patterns, give each a chance and a ramp, chain the patterns in an eight slot sequence or roll the dice. Fits openDAW's device panel.
credits: Built on the CLAP headers by free-audio (MIT).
